title: Escape & Unicode Torture Test 🧪
author: The Latte Project
paragraphs:
(0) The "quoted" word problem: every serializer must escape \ backslashes \ and "double quotes" correctly, plus	tabs and
newlines embedded mid-paragraph.
(0) Unicode beyond ASCII: café, naïve, über, façade, smörgåsbord — accented Latin is the easy half of the problem.
(0) CJK text stresses multi-byte UTF-8 encoding: 性能テストは重要です。序列化速度を測定します。
(0) Emoji are surrogate pairs in UTF-16 and four bytes in UTF-8: 🚀 💡 🎉 ✨ — they punish naive char-by-char escapers.
(0) Control characters like  and  must be \u-escaped per RFC 8259, while / may pass through unescaped.
(0) Mixed content with <html> & ampersands = the characters Gson HTML-escapes by default; semantic equality must survive that.
(0) Greek and Cyrillic round out two-byte UTF-8: αβγδ абвг שלום — plus right-to-left Hebrew for good measure.
(0) A long plain-ASCII paragraph to balance the mix, because most real-world JSON strings are boring identifiers, sentences, and URLs like https://example.com/v1/resources?page=2.
